1.web: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
1.asv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

2.web: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
2.asv: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.

3.web: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
3.asv: For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the deadly pestilence.

4.web: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
4.asv: He will cover thee with his pinions, And under his wings shalt thou take refuge: His truth is a shield and a buckler.

5.web: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day;
5.asv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

6.web: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
6.asv: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

7.web: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
7.asv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; Butit shall not come nigh thee.

8.web: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
8.asv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the reward of the wicked.

9.web: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
9.asv: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge! Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;

10.web: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
10.asv: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.

11.web: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
11.asv: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.

12.web: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
12.asv: They shall bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

13.web: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
13.asv: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under foot.

14.web: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
14.asv: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

15.web: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
15.asv: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble: I will deliver him, and honor him.

16.web: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
16.asv: With long life will I satisfy him, And show him my salvation.
